name: ipv6 dhcp server vrf enable
detail: Enable the DHCP for IPv6 server VRF-aware feature.
noForm: no ipv6 dhcp server vrf enable
usageSummary: The ipv6 dhcp server option vpn command allows the DHCPv6 server VRF-aware feature to be enabled globally on a device.

name: ipv6 flow monitor
detail: This command activates a previously created flow monitor by assigning it to the interface to analyze incoming or outgoing traffic. To activate a previously created flow monitor, use the ipv6 flow monitor command. To de-activate a flow monitor, use the no form of the command.
syntax: ipv6 flow monitor ipv6-monitor-name [sampler ipv6-sampler-name] {input | output}
noForm: no ipv6 flow monitor ipv6-monitor-name [sampler ipv6-sampler-name] {input | output}

params.name: ipv6-monitor-name
params.description: Activates a previously created flow monitor by assigning it to the interface to analyze incoming or outgoing traffic.

params.name: input
params.description: Applies the flow monitor on input traffic.

params.name: output
params.description: Applies the flow monitor on output traffic.

usageSummary: You cannot attach a NetFlow monitor to a port channel interface.  If both service module interfaces are part of an EtherChannel, you should attach the monitor to both physical interfaces.  This example shows how to apply a flow monitor to an interface: Device(config)# interface gigabitethernet 1/1/2 Device(config-if)# ip flow monitor FLOW-MONITOR-1 input Device(config-if)# ip flow monitor FLOW-MONITOR-2 output Device(config-if)# end Command Reference, Cisco IOS XE Gibraltar 16.

name: show ipv6 dhcp binding
detail: Display automatic client bindings from the Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) for IPv6 server binding table.

params.name: ipv6-address
params.description: (Optional) The address of a DHCP for IPv6 client.

params.name: vrf vrf-name
params.description: (Optional) Specifies a virtual routing and forwarding (VRF) configuration.

usageSummary: The show ipv6 dhcp binding command displays all automatic client bindings from the DHCP for IPv6 server binding table if the ipv6-address argument is not specified.  When the ipv6-address argument is specified, only the binding for the specified client is displayed.  If the vrf vrf-namekeyword and argument combination is specified, all bindings that belong to the specified VRF are displayed.
